remarks: 191 15th Street is a single-family home on double lot that has been completely renovated. Newer tear off roof, all new windows, siding, refaced front porch, and newly built side porch. New black top driveway to be installed prior to closing. Inside, on the first floor you'll find an open floor plan with the living room and dining/kitchen area separated by a breakfast bar with a butcher block top. The kitchen has all new cabinetry, appliances, and a center island with a dish washer, and quartz counters as well as a sliding glass door leading to the newly built side porch/yard. The first floor also has a bedroom with a walk-in closet, an office, and a full bath with a stand-up shower. The second floor has a gallery corridor/wide hallway large enough to accommodate a seating area, two large bedrooms, both with walk-in closets, a full bath with a double vanity and tub, and a very spacious laundry room. This home has all new plumbing, electrical wiring, and panels, as well as framing, drywall, flooring, and ducts. New furnace, hot water tank, and central air condenser. Partial basement with access to the crawl space and full attic. Steps to the Five-Points neighborhood, Connecticut Street, and the D'Youville University Campus.
